Personally, I really liked it. I've had bad experiences with tooth extractions elsewhere, but the doctor here was great. He's kind and gentle.

P.S. I saw a male doctor. Another person who saw a female doctor also said she was good.

The service was terrible. The staff seemed unwilling to speak and had unwelcoming expressions.
They kept their heads down, lacking a service-oriented attitude.
They were rude; they wouldn't take my card when I handed it to them, telling me to put it on the counter.
They seemed confused and very tired when I offered it.
I'd rather go to another shop with smiling and friendly service.
They seemed willing to serve.

text:
The service was terrible. I felt very uncomfortable entering the clinic.
From the moment I asked if I needed to change my shoes (since there was no sign indicating this and I had already taken them off outside), they didn't answer. I had to look at them myself before they nodded, as if they were extremely tired and didn't want to talk at all. The service was poor from both the doctor and the staff.

text: If you're not a scheduled patient, don't bother going in. They won't be able to accept new patients; they only accept scheduled patients. New patients will have to wait until all the scheduled patients have been admitted.
The doctor is kind and gentle. My daughter just had a tooth extracted and she didn't cry at all. 😊❤️ …
